يتعجرفوا (form IIq)
# يَتَعَجْرَفُوا (yataʕajrafū) /ja.ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# يُتَعَجْرَفُوا (yutaʕajrafū) /ju.ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
